settings.hero_eyebrow: Built to get you out of bed and into your life
settings.hero_headline: Passionate about mornings and dedicated to helping you own yours.

settings.label: Vision
settings.body: We saw a world drowning in snooze buttons. MOOV was built to change the first moment of every day.
settings.caption_body: The alarm goes off. Most people lose the first battle of the day before they're even awake. We built MOOV to flip that.

settings.label: Journey
settings.body: From a late-night idea to a product that thousands of early risers now rely on every morning.
settings.caption_body: Our founders were chronic snoozers. They tried everything. Nothing worked until they realised the solution was physical, not digital.

settings.label: Promise
settings.body: Simple hardware, smart routines, and zero guilt. MOOV is designed to get you up and into your life.
settings.caption_body: No gamification. No streaks. No pressure. Just a system that quietly makes getting up easier, every single day.
